_comment: Development-board config image for the CURRENT two-board setup (see docs/pogo-interface.md 'development compat mode'). Generates dev_leaf_config.bin, which makes pogo_module.bin behave like the old, separate 'lower' reference project on this one board. NOT representative of final hardware: there is no DETECT/BASE_ID wiring yet, and the sensor is the development-only mock (see docs/module-config.md).
_upstream_comment: The board's only physical UART, mapped to UPSTREAM -- matches the original lower project's GPIO10(TX)/GPIO11(RX)/UART1/115200 8N1.
_downstream_comment: Disabled entirely on this board: role_manager is forced to LEAF by dev_mode instead of deriving it from a (nonexistent) DOWNSTREAM peer.
